ja.title: 測定していない薬の細胞応答をAIはどう予測するのか
ja.summary: MAPの未測定薬剤予測を、残した知識と未知にした情報から読む。公開された16薬剤の評価値を再集計し、平均相関の改善、候補ごとのばらつき、知識学習の段階差と次の検証条件を整理する。
ja.seo_title: 測定していない薬の細胞応答をAIはどう予測するのか

en.title: How can AI predict cellular responses to drugs that have not been profiled?
en.summary: A descriptive audit of published MAP scores for 16 held-out drugs and four knowledge-pretraining stages, distinguishing unprofiled compounds from unseen structural or mechanistic groups. No model training or inference was performed.
en.seo_title: MAP drug response predictions for unprofiled compounds
en.seo_description: A reanalysis of released MAP predictions examines drug response accuracy, context coverage and what knowledge-informed gains establish.
